text:
Emma (People Ops): Heads-up — we just noticed an off-cycle file we sent to the payroll vendor this morning used the wrong deduction code for 401k (used `401K-PR` instead of `401K-PRE`). Several new hires were affected. Anyone able to confirm impact and next steps?
Jack (Payroll): Yikes. Which payrun?
Emma (People Ops): Off-cycle 2024-06-14 manual corrections batch. ~8 folks, small amounts.
Ana (Benefits): If contributions were taken as post-tax instead of pre-tax, employees could see tax differences on their paystub. Need vendor to reclassify to pre-tax on their ledger and refile S125 / year-to-date for the affected employees.
Tom (HRIS): I pulled the CSV — snippet: `employee_id,amount,deduction_code
98765,250,401K-PR
99234,150,401K-PR` — we should have used `401K-PRE`.
Jack (Payroll): Vendor cutoff for retro corrections is EOD tomorrow for June month close. If we miss cutoff, corrections will be done in next month which complicates taxes.
Priya (Finance): Is there tax withholding exposure we need to reserve for? Rough estimate of total misclassified = $1,400 pre-tax should have been pre-tax but treated post-tax?
Ana (Benefits): If treated post-tax, employee take-home might be slightly higher now but taxable income unchanged on their W-2 if we correct before month close. If not corrected, we'll need to do a gross-up/adjustment. Vendor will confirm.
Emma (People Ops): Action items: 1) Jack — open an urgent ticket with vendor to reprocess these 8 rows as `401K-PRE` and send confirmation. 2) Tom — resend corrected CSV with a note. 3) Priya — please estimate any withholding reserve and flag accounting. 4) Ana — confirm whether vendor needs signed authorization for off-cycle reclassification.
Jack (Payroll): On it — filing ticket now. Ticket ID `PB-8421`. Pinged vendor contact @payroll_support and attached CSV.
PayrollBot: Ticket PB-8421 created and assigned to payroll-support. Estimated vendor response: 6 business hours.
Tom (HRIS): Re-sent corrected CSV to vendor with `CORRECT_DED_CODE` header and note: `please reclassify as pre-tax, attach confirmation file`.
Priya (Finance): I'll hold a $2k reserve on the payroll account as a precaution and loop in accounting.
Ana (Benefits): Vendor replied: they can reclassify before cutoff but need written confirmation from Redwood and the signed vendor correction form for compliance. Can we sign today?
Emma (People Ops): I can sign the vendor correction form — uploading in thread. Also will send template email to affected employees explaining what's happening and that their net pay may adjust after correction.
Jack (Payroll): Vendor confirmed reprocessing started. Will update when confirmations are available and when GL entries hit.
Priya (Finance): Noted. I'll reconcile once vendor confirms.
Emma (People Ops): Thanks team — please mark as high priority. I'll follow up with the employee notifications when Jack confirms final results. :thumbsup:
